'''Manister Base''' was a large military base built by the [[Citizens' Militia]] in the [[Northern Jundland Wastes]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was overrun by [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosians]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Manister Base was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].
